Multiage Knowledge/Integrated Block Lesson Planner

Plan the whole-group Knowledge/Integrated lesson for your cluster. If you select more than 3 grades, this splits into a K-2 block and a 3-5 block — each with its own Unit, Lesson, and standards. Target and Task are what you adjust per grade level, anchored to the grade whose materials you're actually planning from.
Check the grades in your cluster to start planning.

This browser autosaves your work as you type. Use Save My Plan to download a file you can reopen later or on another device, and Load a Plan to bring one back in.

Reflects whichever grades are checked in "Grades in Your Cluster" on the Multiage tab — one section per grade. K-2 sections show both Skills Strand and Knowledge Strand centers side by side, since both exist at those grades; Grade 3-5 sections show Knowledge/Integrated centers only, since those grades don't have a separate Skills Strand. Either way, centers are suggested lesson by lesson from KPBSD's CKLA centers (per the Multiage ELA Playbook, Part III).
